evidence_limitations: A random 256-bit challenge is locally fresh but cannot prove global freshness without authenticated external witness state
Correct SSHSIG verification proves possession of the same-admin signing key, not external independent authority
Hashes of claimed external roots, guardian domains and historical anchors are attacker-controlled input until separately authenticated
A local challenge cache and a locally stored high-water record remain coherently rollbackable
No real external operator, legal custodian identity, remote host attestation or independent quorum was supplied
next_nonlocal_prerequisites: Obtain separately authorized actual guardian and verify real administrative control independently
Owner must authenticate guardian public key fingerprint over a secure out-of-band channel
Independent witness must retain protected non-rollbackable challenge, key epoch, nonce and revocation high-water state
Bureau must review independent identity, control separation, incident recovery and quorum before any admission
